steps:
Relate each pair by a horizontal shift using the cofunction identities.

  1. (i) Cotangent has asymptotes at multiples of 180° and zeros at odd multiples of 90°; −tanx has asymptotes at odd multiples of 90° and zeros at multiples of 180°. Both decrease on each branch. (ii) Translate −tanx by 90° horizontally in either direction to obtain cotx.
